integrity: The central identity is proved symbolically and the exact witness is replayed by a standalone standard-library verifier. Literature comparisons are limited to inspected sources and do not claim exhaustive uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the finite-period semi-trivial orbit with zero predator supplementation. It does not classify positive periodic solutions, and a 2022 weighted-escapement predecessor was available only through abstract and bibliographic material during the literature comparison.
title: Exact cancellation removes the predator-harvest stability threshold
